description: This Kotlin file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter used for rendering different sections on a home screen in an Android TV application. It includes view holders for header, banner, and content row sections, along with their binding logic and UI behaviors.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView.Adapter managing different section types for the home screen including header, banner, and content rows.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type based on the item at a given position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates ViewHolders based on view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolders based on item type.

inner_classes.name: HeaderSectionVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder for header section, manages brand styling and top navbar interactions.

inner_classes.name: BannerSectionVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder for banner section, manages horizontal banner pager setup.

inner_classes.name: ContentRowSectionVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder for content row sections, manages horizontal list of cards.

classes.name: SectionItem
classes.description: Sealed class representing different sections on the home screen: header, banner, and content row.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binding logic specific to each ViewHolder for setting up UI components with data.
